channel.title: IHCC news and announcements
channel.description: Official announcements of the International Hand Cricket Council.

item.title: Every Member Board now has its own page
item.description: The 13 Member Boards each have a page with the board's leaders, its squad and its announcements. Only the display name and the real name of a player are shown, and nothing else about a player is ever public. The Team Director, the Deputy Director and the Media Manager of a board look after the page from a Management page. Open the Member Boards

item.title: ODI is now 16 overs
item.description: The Boards changed the length of ODI from 15 to 16 overs. All 13 Member Boards approved it, which is more than the two-thirds majority needed. T20 stays 12 overs and Test stays 20 overs.

item.title: IHCC is now on YouTube
item.description: The official IHCC YouTube channel is now open. Its name is IHCC Hand Cricket and its handle is @IHCCHandCricket. Open the YouTube channel

item.title: Match formats decided
item.description: The Boards decided the length of the three formats: T20 is 12 overs, ODI is 15 overs and Test is 20 overs. Update of 31 October 2026: ODI is now 16 overs. See the news of that day.

item.title: Decision on player display names
item.description: The Boards voted on the display names of players. Of the 15 Boards, 11 voted: 9 in favour and 2 against. Every player, male or female, uses the verified name of a male cricketer of his or her board's country. The cricketer must have played at least one international match for that country, in T20, ODI or Test. A cricketer who has played only domestic cricket cannot be used.

item.title: Squad lists now go through board representatives
item.description: Each Member Board now sends its squad list through one board representative, who signs in with Google. Players do not fill in a form themselves. A board needs 12 to 20 players, and the first 12 are the voters. The last date is 31 October 2026, 11:59 PM Pakistan time. Read how it works

item.title: The official WhatsApp channel is live
item.description: All official announcements of IHCC are also shared on the IHCC WhatsApp channel. Follow the WhatsApp channel
